messages:
alex_p: Quick Q — thinking about adding a client-provided 'turnstile' rate hint header for the embeddings endpoint (like X-Embed-Turnstile). idea is to surface expected QPS/units to the router + console so we can make smarter fastpath vs slowpath decisions.
maya: Why not just use our runtime estimator? we already derive units from dims + bytes.
sam_r: runtime estimator works but it's noisy for bursty clients — a hint would let routing smooth bursts without overprovisioning.
jordan: Concern: trusting client-provided hints is risky (spoofing, buggy SDKs). we'd need to treat it as advisory, not authoritative.
alex_p: yep — advisory only. plan: router will prefer hint when present but fall back to runtime-estimate. also record telemetry flags: turnstile_hint_seen / turnstile_hint_used.
maya: good. on telemetry: add a sampling path so we can compare hint vs observed tokens/units for a subset of requests. helps detect bad clients.
sam_r: console UX: we can surface a new column in tenant dashboard "client QPS hint" and a delta metric (hint vs observed) + alert when mismatch > 2x.
jordan: rollout plan: 1) opt-in header (clients set X-Embed-Turnstile: <units/s>), 2) server logs hint but ignores for first week (collect metrics), 3) enable advisory routing for canary tenants, 4) global advisory.
alex_p: code proto for header: ```
# curl example
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Embed-Turnstile: 12.5" \
     -d '{"input": ["..."], "model": "open-embed-1"}' \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
maya: telemetry tags we want: embed.turnstile.hint_value, embed.turnstile.derived_units, embed.turnstile.hint_used:boolean, embed.turnstile.sample_group. Also include request.reason=fastpath/slowpath.
sam_r: routing: if hint_used and hint > threshold => we can allocate small dedicated slot in fastpath pool for that tenant for short window. but must have circuit-breaker if observed units far lower.
jordan: security: header should be signed for private deployments? maybe optional HMAC header for enterprise customers to avoid spoofing in on-prem/private envs.
alex_p: agreed. default: public hosted API treats it unauthenticated advisory. enterprise/private can opt into signed-hint feature (docs + KMS integration for signing).
maya: perf note: parsing header is cheap, but it can change bucketing decisions — we need to ensure per-connection cache invalidation doesn't thrash. prefer short TTL for the hint (like 30s) and treat it as rate window, not absolute.
sam_r: can we backfill console with historical comparisons? want 30d view of hint/observed for billing + anomaly detection.
alex_p: yes — plan to push sampling stream to metrics pipeline and a nightly job to compute aggregates.
deploy-bot: canary started for eng-platform team (canary id: embed-turnstile-2024-09). watch /metrics/embed/turnstile.* for anomalies.
jordan: small nit — header name should be shorter: "Embed-Turnstile" vs "X-Embed-Turnstile". prefer no X- prefix at this point.
alex_p: ok we'll use Embed-Turnstile. i'll draft an RFC with telemetry fields, console mockups, and the canary checklist. tagging people for review: @maya @sam_r @jordan :thumbsup:
maya: +1
sam_r: +1 :rocket:
jordan: +1 :eyes:
